description:
The AcmeCorp development team has deployed a Java application server on port 8443 and a WebSocket service on port 9090. Additionally, the security team has identified malicious scanning traffic from the 198.51.100.0/24 IP range.

Using Webmin's Linux Firewall module (Networking > Linux Firewall), configure the following three iptables rules in the INPUT chain:

1. ACCEPT incoming TCP traffic on destination port 8443
2. ACCEPT incoming TCP traffic on destination port 9090
3. DROP all incoming traffic from source network 198.51.100.0/24

Ensure you apply the configuration so the rules become active.
